name: Permanent Residence -- Family/Ancestry Route

requirements.blocker_text: Spouses of Grenadian citizens become eligible for this Permanent Residence route after 3 years of marriage.
Available to persons with a Grenadian-born parent or grandparent.

evidence_required.document: Proof of parent's or grandparent's birth in Grenada (ancestry route)

sources.title: Osher Advisors -- Grenada Permanent Residency: family-based route (spouses eligible after 3 years of marriage; ancestry-based available to those with Grenadian-born parents or grandparents), 1-12 month processing

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Grenada's initial build. STATUS: DRAFT -- tier-3 sourcing only, same as gd_permanent_residence_general.json. IMPORTANT OVERLAP FLAG: the 'ancestry' OR-group here (grandparent OR parent born in Grenada) is BROADER than the constitutional citizenship-by-descent rule confirmed via tier-1 sourcing (Section 97 of the Constitution grants citizenship registration only to children of a Grenadian PARENT, not grandparent -- see gd_citizenship_by_descent.json). It is plausible this tier-3 source is conflating this PR route with that citizenship route, or that a genuinely separate, broader PR-only ancestry allowance exists reaching back a generation further -- NOT independently confirmed via a tier-1 source, so treat this specific group with extra caution. The marriage OR-group is likewise a genuinely separate track from gd_citizenship_by_marriage.json's direct-registration route (which has no stated residence-duration requirement) -- a spouse may in principle choose either the immediate citizenship registration route or this slower PR-first route, per the sources reviewed.
